quotes.quote: America faces a workforce shortage across the sectors that matter most: healthcare, veterinary medicine, education and business. We don't have enough professionals to meet growing demands. Organizations are investing in technology and innovation, but technology alone won't solve this crisis. Meaningful progress requires people—and higher education models built for how they actually live and work.
Build customized, practice-ready pipelines—nurses, physicians, behavioral health specialists—learning in your facilities, your way.

revenue_model.value: service fees: tuition and fees paid by students, often funded by federal student aid and loans; project or contract: employer partnership programs with health systems such as scholarships and loan repayment arrangements

quotes.quote: A multi-state BSN program where students learn in SSM Health facilities, taught by a blend of Chamberlain and SSM Health faculty, using SSM Health standards. Students commit to employment in exchange for loan repayment over four years.

Increase retention by preparing clinicians for your practice environments and standards of care. Structure benefits like loan repayment tied to employment commitments and create advancement pathways that give employees reasons to stay and grow within your system.

quotes.quote: Our graduates enter the workforce ready from day one—clinically skilled, hands-on prepared and comfortable with AI-powered tools. For employers, this means professionals who can hit the ground running.

Our graduates are practice ready from day one. Through partnering with leaders such as Google Cloud and, Hippocratic AI, we work to integrate AI and technology directly into clinical education. Students develop skills in our simulation labs and complete clinical rotations at hundreds of partner hospitals and healthcare systems—learning the workflows, technology and protocols they'll use in practice. This is how we deliver workforce solutions at scale.
